## rss-mcp
Local-first RSS reader + readability extractor with LanceDB/FastEmbed semantic search.

**Before starting work, check subscriptions and unread items:**
1. `feeds_ops(operation="list_feeds")` -> review subscribed feeds
2. `reader_ops(operation="inbox")` -> check recent unread articles

**At end of work, ensure feed state and cache are clean:**
- `reader_ops(operation="stats")` -> verify item counts and cached clean extracts
